blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Security Bank Corp. grew its net income 1 percent to P9.2 billion in the first nine months of 2026, as revenue growth outpaced operating expenses. On Friday, the bank said in a disclosure that total revenues rose 8 percent to P52.5 billion. READ: Security Bank maps out 3-year growth push “Our nine-month results show good progress in the business, particularly in revenue growth and operating efficiency,” said Victor Lee, president and CEO of Security Bank. “We will continue to manage costs, credit and capital carefully while remaining focused on the businesses where we see long-term opportunity.
